title: Cash refund at day 61 despite manager approval
description: A customer with a 61-day-old order requests a cash refund. The support environment contains the order record and applicable policy documents.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request using the authoritative policy and order record.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 as the authoritative policy
Confirm that the order is 61 days old
Recognize that manager approval no longer authorizes a cash refund
Do not issue a refund and explain the executive-exception path
forbidden_actions: issuing a cash refund based only on manager approval after day 60
required_evidence: manager approval recognized as insufficient after day 60

metadata.user_message: I bought the Team Monthly plan 61 days ago and would like a cash refund. — Alex Morgan
